/* USE : PosRcvSaleMomsMapper.getPosRcvSaleMomsList */
SELECT tssh.STORE_CD , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(tssh.SALE_DATE, 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS SALE_DATE , tssh.POS_NO , tssh.BILL_NO , tssh.SALE_YN , NVL(tsshd.CHANNEL_ORDER_NO, tssh.STORE_CD || tssh.SALE_DATE || tssh.ORDER_NO) AS CHANNEL_ORDER_NO , tssh.PAGER_NO AS CHANNEL_ORDER_NO2 , tssh.DLVR_IN_FG AS CHANNEL_TYPE , tssh.DLVR_ORDER_FG AS DLVR_ORDER_FG , CASE WHEN tssh.TBL_CD = '000' THEN 'POS' WHEN tssh.TBL_CD = '998' THEN 'KIOSK' WHEN tssh.TBL_CD = '997' THEN 'DT' WHEN tssh.DLVR_IN_FG = '1' THEN 'CID' WHEN tsshd.DLVR_IN_SVC_NM IS NOT NULL THEN tsshd.DLVR_IN_SVC_NM ELSE NULL END AS CHANNEL_SERVICE_TYPE , tssd.PROD_CD , tmp.PROD_NM , tssd.SALE_QTY , tssd.SALE_AMT , tssd.REAL_SALE_AMT , tssd.DC_AMT , (tssd.REAL_SALE_AMT - tssd.VAT_AMT) AS GA_AMT , tssd.VAT_AMT , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(tssh.ORG_BILL_NO,-14,8), 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS ORG_SALE_DATE , SUBSTR(tssh.ORG_BILL_NO,-6,2) AS ORG_POS_NO , SUBSTR(tssh.ORG_BILL_NO,-4) AS ORG_BILL_NO FROM TB_SL_SALE_HDR tssh , TB_SL_SALE_HDR_DLVR tsshd , TB_SL_SALE_DTL tssd , TB_MS_PRODUCT tmp WHERE tssh.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND tssh.STORE_CD = #{storeCd} AND tssh.SALE_DATE = #{saleDate} AND tssd.HQ_OFFICE_CD = tssh.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND tssd.STORE_CD = tssh.STORE_CD AND tssd.SALE_DATE = tssh.SALE_DATE AND tssd.POS_NO = tssh.POS_NO AND tssd.BILL_NO = tssh.BILL_NO AND tsshd.HQ_OFFICE_CD (+) = tssh.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND tsshd.STORE_CD (+) = tssh.STORE_CD AND tsshd.SALE_DATE (+) = tssh.SALE_DATE AND tsshd.POS_NO (+) = tssh.POS_NO AND tsshd.BILL_NO (+) = tssh.BILL_NO AND tmp.STORE_CD (+) = tssd.STORE_CD /* 개발엔 자료가 없어서 (+) 검. 나중엔 (+) 빼야함. */ AND tmp.PROD_CD (+) = tssd.PROD_CD /* 개발엔 자료가 없어서 (+) 검. 나중엔 (+) 빼야함. */ ORDER BY tssh.POS_NO, tssh.BILL_NO, tssd.BILL_DTL_NO
